instructions: Prepare the vegetables, aromatics, turkey, and sweet potato for mediterranean turkey sweet potato hash.
Heat the cooking vessel and soften the aromatics until fragrant.
Add the seasoned turkey and cook it until browned or heated through as appropriate.
Stir in the sweet potato, vegetables, and sauce and cook until the mixture is tender and cohesive.
Taste the mediterranean turkey sweet potato hash, adjust the seasoning, and portion it evenly while warm.
